description.value: La Belle Patate is a Québécois fast-food restaurant specializing in authentic poutine, insisting on fresh cheese curds with the signature squeak that any proud Francophone would recognize. The Esquimalt location is one of two outposts (the other in Vancouver), serving both eat-in and takeout. Cyclists passing through Esquimalt will find a quick, hearty stop for classic Québec comfort food.
